title: Playing with vowels and consonants
summary: Practise telling vowel letters and consonants apart in everyday Spanish words.
keyIdeas: The five vowel letters are A, E, I, O and U.
The other letters of the Spanish alphabet are consonants.
We join vowels and consonants to make syllables and words.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas la producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: Hugo needs a vowel letter for a game. Which letter is a vowel?
activities.explanation: E is a vowel letter. M and P are consonants.
activities.hint: Remember the five vowel letters: A, E, I, O, U.

activities.prompt: The letter S is a consonant.
activities.explanation: The five vowel letters are A, E, I, O and U. S is a consonant.

activities.prompt: Sort these letters into the correct box.
activities.explanation: A, O and U are vowel letters. T, L and P are consonants.

activities.prompt: Match each Spanish word to the vowel letter it begins with.
activities.explanation: Each word begins with a different vowel letter: «avión» with A, «elefante» with E, «isla» with I and «oso» with O.

activities.prompt: Complete the Spanish sentence about the word «SOL».
activities.explanation: In «SOL», O is a vowel letter between two consonants, S and L.
activities.sentence: En la palabra SOL, la letra O es una ___.

activities.prompt: Put the five vowel letters in alphabetical order.
activities.explanation: The five vowel letters appear in this order: A, E, I, O, U.

activities.prompt: Read the short Spanish text and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Read carefully and count the vowel letters in «GATO».
activities.title: El gato de Aisha
activities.text: Aisha tiene un gato blanco. Se llama Peluso. A Peluso le gusta jugar con lana y dormir al sol.

questions.explanation: The text tells us that the cat is called Peluso.

questions.prompt: How many vowel letters are in the Spanish word «GATO»?
questions.explanation: There are two vowel letters in «GATO»: A and O.

activities.prompt: Omar lists these vowel letters: A, E, M, U. Which consonant has he included by mistake?
activities.explanation: M is a consonant, so it does not belong in a list of vowel letters.
activities.hint: Which of the three choices is not a vowel letter?

activities.prompt: Sort these Spanish words by their first letter.
activities.explanation: «uva», «estrella» and «iglú» begin with vowels: u, e and i. «barco», «mesa» and «casa» begin with consonants: b, m and c.

activities.prompt: Adrián wants a Spanish word with two vowel letters and two consonants. Which word fits?
activities.explanation: «LUNA» has two consonants, L and N, and two vowels, U and A. «SOL» has only one vowel. «PLÁTANO» has more letters.
